intervention_description: Asset transfer program providing livestock, cash stipends, skills training, and savings support to ultra-poor households

graduation_components_rationale.consumption_support: Weekly cash stipend of 70 Takas provided
graduation_components_rationale.healthcare: BRAC community health volunteers provided healthcare services
graduation_components_rationale.assets: Livestock and productive asset transfers were core program component
graduation_components_rationale.skills_training: Technical and entrepreneurship training provided for 2 years
graduation_components_rationale.savings: Program required and encouraged savings habit
graduation_components_rationale.coaching: Intensive staff supervision with weekly household visits
graduation_components_rationale.social_empowerment: Village Assistance Committees established to support ultra-poor

outcomes.outcome_description: Real per capita income in constant 2000 Takas
outcomes.literal_text: Real per capita income increased by 74 percent (2005-2008)

outcomes.outcome_description: Computed asset stock index in Takas
outcomes.literal_text: Average value of asset stocks decreased by 12 percent between 2005 and 2008
Land ownership increased by 50 percent between 2005 and 2008

outcomes.outcome_description: Proportion of households with cash savings
outcomes.literal_text: 98 percent of SUPs had cash savings in 2008 compared to fewer than ten percent in 2002

outcomes.outcome_name: Real per capita income change factors
outcomes.outcome_description: Impact of household characteristics on per capita income (Takas)
outcomes.literal_text: Female-headed households: -494 Takas, Literacy: +168 Takas, Household size: -461 Takas per member
